sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: Open-Source LLM for Private Deployment & Custom AI ...
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is a 7.6B-parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team. It supports up to 128K token context length with 8K generation capacity, multilingual support (29+ languages), and has been optimized for coding, mathematics, JSON generation, and long-form text. Licensed under Apache 2.0 and ungated, it is designed for deployment as a private or custom LLM ...
